q2_gaps: A CAPITALIZED COMMON NOUN premodifying a common-noun head ("the old Council hall"): the instruction set covers a proper-noun premodifier (head parsed normally + opaque `Possession` to the named entity) and a standalone capitalized common-noun label ("the Assembly" — common noun by default, no `Name`), but not the case where a capitalized common noun is itself the premodifier, so whether it fuses into a compound kind or takes the `Possession` route is undetermined.
notes: Under the "capitalized common noun is a common noun by default" reading the parse is right throughout: `council_hall` fuses as a classifying subtype with the `hall` genus emitted and the noun modifier unexposed, "old" stays a separate descriptive atom, and `collapse` correctly takes an intransitive change-of-state `Patient` plus `Past`.
